prompts.prompt: Create a brand new, exceptional cinematic environmental artwork for a literary desktop app called Parhelion Theatre. Wide landscape 3:2 or 16:10 image, no text whatsoever, no UI, no lettering. Theme: the different plays performed in this theatre ARE separate REAL inhabited worlds, not toy stage sets or painted scenery. Composition: front-on audience view through a majestic but restrained tall rectangular classical proscenium. Deep midnight indigo plush velvet side curtains occupy the extreme left and right 12%, with elegant thin antique brass edging, no rococo clutter, upper valance just 10%. A dark polished stage apron at the very bottom leads seamlessly into a vast REAL seaside astronomical city at blue hour: layered inhabited stone terraces, bridges, dome observatories, warm windows, a broad calm estuary, tiny people for convincing life-size scale, distant mountain islands fading with atmospheric perspective and horizon. The world continues infinitely beyond the stage, an impossible open reality. Above the city a pale warm sun with two subtle smaller parhelion side reflections in a soft amber halo, positioned upper center-right. Airy haze and a few thin clouds, real air, beautiful calm glints in water. Colors midnight #151c2d, teal blue, smoky peach and candle gold. Image focus center and right, deep real world 65% of image, no small circular planet or mini diorama. A tactile proscenium frame feels physically near, the city genuinely kilometers deep. Art directed premium matte-painting realism with soft film grain, luminous but restrained, no oversaturated rainbow, no floating islands, no decorative objects, no books, no typography. Strong architectural framing, contemporary sophisticated fantasy editorial, enough brightness to see the world clearly.

Produce a completely new architectural cinematic CGI environmental illustration for a premium novel writing app. Wide landscape 16:10 image. The idea: a modern theatre's revolving stage connects several separate, REAL full-scale inhabited worlds. No UI, no labels, no text, no book covers. View from a slightly elevated oblique audience position, looking across a very wide dark charcoal revolving theatre stage, its curved edge seen across the lower quarter. Two tall monumental matte charcoal movable scenic walls, deliberately offset and angled, are in the near foreground at left and center-right, very few structures, large elegant negative shapes. Between them a breathtaking REAL cobalt blue astronomical harbor city opens into deep space: giant detailed antique observatory towers, thousands of inhabited glowing tiny windows, bridges over a fjord, ships and people very small in correct scale, dusky teal mountains and an immense pale pearl sun with two subtle atmospheric side reflections. On the far right, past an angled wall, a NARROW glimpse of a separate warm red desert civilization under a different sky. Spatial geometry coherent: each view extends miles into its own world behind the walls, no small toy models sitting on platforms, not a group of three doorways, not three picture frames. Include the stage's very subtle concentric mechanical seams and brushed metal rim, warm theatrical sidelighting on the charcoal concrete, realistic shadows from the tall walls. Colors ink black #151616, limestone #d9d6ca, arctic turquoise #80c9cd and controlled ochre light. Extremely art-directed luxury architecture photography quality with precise scale, dramatic wide composition and luminous atmospheric depth, crisp details in the central living city. Do not make a sci-fi spaceship, do not add crowds, no decorative prisms, no floating spheres, no neon rainbow. The image must convey a monumental real theatre opening into actual distant worlds.

Make a completely original finely illustrated theatrical literary plate, landscape 4:3 composition, NO text, NO letters, NO typography, NO UI, NO page numbers. A beautiful highly detailed antique-inspired wood engraving and mineral-color screenprint showing a theatre proscenium whose opened pleated red-brown curtains reveal a vast REAL inhabited maritime observatory city. The city extends across many terraces all the way to a distant sea horizon: tall domed astronomical observatories, stone bridges, narrow rooftops, tiny people walking on quay, ships, gardens, stone stairs and waterways, beautiful geographic specificity like a travel record from a real alternative world. Large subtly hatched pale sun, two small optical companion suns and concentric thin halos above horizon. Theatrical curtains on both edges and a scalloped upper valance, slender geometric columns, a tiny visible dark stage apron in the foreground. Prioritize the panoramic living world, never a miniature toy diorama. Illustration style: precise copperplate and woodcut hatch lines, artisanal slightly imperfect overprinted flat mineral colors, deep Prussian blue #234b59 and faded brick red #a74b3d on warm uncoated ivory paper #ece6d7. Some light pale golden ink on the sky. Very refined art book illustration, sophisticated restrained composition, exquisite linework, strong broad negative sky and gorgeous world details below. Flat printed image, no photoreal 3D mockup, no book, no photographed paper edges, no white border or frame. Full bleed edge to edge art, avoid dense decorative baroque flourishes, avoid digital gradients.
